sources.title: toyllm - AI Model Insights & Benchmarks
sources.snippet: ToyLLM: Learning LLM from Scratch A hands-on educational project for understanding and implementing Large Language Models (LLMs) from scratch. This project provides implementations of GPT-2 and related techniques, making it an excellent resource for learning about transformer architectures and modern language models.
